resources.string: Enter the public HTTPS address of your existing BOLT12 Pay web app. The companion receives BOLT11/BOLT12 links, Lightning addresses, and Amethyst\'s BIP321 handoff and opens them there for review.
Use the exact HTTPS base address where your current BOLT12 Pay app and /pay-intent are available.
Enter an HTTPS address without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.
The server address could not be saved permanently.
A Lightning link is waiting. Saving will only open the payment form.
Payments are never automatic. BOLT12 Pay first shows the destination and amount in the existing web payment form.
Accepted inputs are lightning: links containing a BOLT11 invoice, BOLT12 offer, or Lightning address, plus Amethyst\'s BIP321 handoff. LNURL and Bitcoin-only payments are not forwarded.
No browser was found for the secure handoff to the BOLT12 Pay web app.
The selected distributor did not provide encrypted WebPush keys.
An incoming notification could not be decrypted.
The UnifiedPush distributor removed this registration. Pair the device again.
Immediate notifications from your own BOLT12 Pay server
Android notification permission is required for payment alerts.
The pairing link is incomplete or invalid.
The UnifiedPush distributor is creating an encrypted endpoint. Reopen the Companion shortly to confirm the status.
No configured UnifiedPush distributor was found. Install or configure one such as Sunup, ntfy, or your self-hosted distributor, then retry.
Pairing is waiting for the push distributor
Optional and Google-free: WebPush encrypts payment alerts end to end. Your chosen distributor sees only timing and encrypted data.
Off by default. When enabled, genuine BOLT12 payer notes and Lightning Address or LNURL comments can appear in the private notification. Technical invoice descriptions are never shown.
Save your BOLT12 Pay HTTPS server first.
